warning_text: GOVERNMENT WARNING: (1) ACCORDING TO THE SURGEON GENERAL, WOMEN SHOULD NOT DRINK ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES DURING PREGNANCY BECAUSE OF THE RISK OF BIRTH DEFECTS. (2) CONSUMPTION OF ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGE IMPAIRS YOUR ABILITY TO DRIVE A CAR OR OPERATE MACHINERY, AND MAY CAUSE HEALTH PROBLEMS.
notes: The warning says 'ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGE IMPAIRS' in sentence (2), singular, where 27 CFR 16.21 says 'alcoholic beverages impairs'. Read from a rotated, enlarged crop of the front image.
The warning is set sideways up the right edge of the image TTB tags as the brand label; the label carries no other copy of it.

The two faces declare the same values in different words. The front reads '40 % ALC. BY VOL - 700 mL', with a space before the per-cent sign and a lower-case 'mL'. The back reads '40% ALC. BY VOL' and '700 ML', sideways up its left edge. The front's wording is transcribed above because that face carries the mandatory text.
Brand is handwriting script with an accented E: 'Terre et Bois de Pradière'. The 'de' is set small between 'Bois' and 'Pradière'.
The scan is low-resolution at the warning; the final mark after 'PROBLEMS' reads as a full stop.
